gate_scope: new pilot surface, read-only public API + local reachability probes, no persistence, no database write
primary_truth_lit_rule: Every Hearthfire surface should glow because something is true.

visual_receipts.state_source: GitHub public REST API, /repos/SingsEnochian/Flameclyffe/actions/runs, fetched on load and on Refresh only
visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: Shows the most recent GitHub Actions workflow runs across all workflows in this repo, each with its real name, status/conclusion, short commit SHA, and update time, or the real HTTP/network error if the fetch failed.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: No auto-polling, to stay clear of the public API's unauthenticated rate limit. Every field comes directly from the API response; nothing is synthesized or guessed.

visual_receipts.state_source: fetch(url, { mode: 'no-cors' }) reachability probes against a fixed list of known local dev ports
visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: Shows whether each known local service (Grove, Ollama, DSpark proxy, Mythic Bridge, STARWELL dev server) is currently reachable from this browser, or honestly 'not reachable' if it isn't.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: A no-cors fetch can only tell us whether something answered, not what it said. This card is only meaningful when viewed locally; a public visitor's browser cannot reach localhost and will correctly see everything as unreachable.
